body_html:
The Global Sonic armchair brings comfort and mobility together in one clean, contemporary seat. A cushioned upholstered seat pairs with a durable molded polypropylene back and a chrome four-leg caster base, so it rolls easily between meetings and stacks away when the room needs to change. It is a confident fit for reception areas, waiting rooms, training spaces and any setting where guests deserve a comfortable place to sit.

Features

  • Upholstered seat over foam for added comfort, paired with an easy-clean polypropylene back
  • Chrome four-leg base on carpet casters for effortless mobility
  • Stackable design for fast room turnover and compact storage
  • Ships fully assembled — ready to roll out of the box
  • Rated for users up to 300 lbs
  • Wide selection of seat upholstery and back colour combinations to match any space

Specifications

Overall dimensions are 23"W x 21.5"D x 32.5"H, with an approximate chair weight of 15 lbs. Frame finishes include chrome and a range of eco-friendly painted options. ANSI/BIFMA and GREENGUARD certified, and backed by a limited lifetime warranty on the frame and components, with 5 years on upholstery and foam.

Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group and offered by Brant Business Interiors, a family-owned dealer in Peterborough, Ontario since 1964. As an OECM-eligible supplier, we make it simple for Ontario institutional buyers to purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote on the Sonic 6574 today, or call 1-800-835-9565.
